summary: Iteration 2: Premium waitlist (API + UI) and iteration-1 regression fixes. Backend 12/12 pytest pass (401/422/429, join->GET persistence, email actually sent via Emergent email 202 + email_id stored, waitlist does not spend credits, free browse no spend, ask -1, ingest replace at 0 credits -> 402 with workspace unchanged). UI: top-bar button, dialog prefilled subject, short-reason validation message, buy-dialog link swaps dialogs, Billing premium card COMING SOON + Join waitlist, success message, labels flip to 'On premium waitlist' / 'You're on the waitlist'. Regression: /ask?q runs once, URL cleared to /ask, reload doesn't charge; /reconcile?a&b prefills and does not auto-run. Found one bug: prefilled reconcile uses stale preset dashboards. Only 2 real emails sent (1 API, 1 UI).

minor.issue: premium_router was imported and include_router'd twice (duplicate route registration). FIXED by testing agent.

Entry is inserted before the email send; if email fails (5xx) the entry stays, user sees an error but GET reports joined=true and it counts toward the 3/day limit. Consider inserting after successful send or marking status=email_failed.

ui_bugs.issue: When opened via /reconcile?a=..&b=.. (migration-plan links) or /reconcile?a=.. (MetricDetail link) without dashboard_a/dashboard_b, dashboards default to PRESETS[0] (d_sales_qbr / d_board). Select A shows 'Any dashboard' (option not present) but state is d_sales_qbr, so clicking Reconcile errors 'Sales QBR does not show Net Sales (eCom)'. Repro: /reconcile?a=m_net_sales_ecom&b=m_net_rev_fin -> click Reconcile. Fix: when params.get('a')/('b') present, default da/db to params.get('dashboard_a') ?? '' (same for b). No credit was charged on the error (good). Also MetricDetail link passes only a, so b falls back to m_net_rev_fin which may equal a.

issues: After successful join the 'Join waitlist' submit stays enabled with subject retained, and the billing 'You're on the waitlist' button reopens the full form -> easy to send duplicate emails (up to 3/day). Consider showing a joined state / disabling submit after success.
Dialog state (reason text) persists between opens - minor

action_items: Fix Reconcile prefill: default dashboard_a/dashboard_b to '' when a/b come from URL params (migration-plan and MetricDetail links currently error)
(Minor) Prevent duplicate waitlist submits after success in the dialog
(Minor) Waitlist: don't persist/count entry if email send fails, or mark it failed
critical_code_review_comments: premium.py uses sync pymongo calls inside async def join_waitlist (blocks event loop briefly); use run_in_threadpool or make it def and use sync httpx
Rate-limit check count_documents + insert_one is non-atomic; concurrent posts could exceed 3/day (low impact)
update_one to set email_id filters on user_id+created_at instead of the inserted _id; use insert result inserted_id

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; reconcile prefill dashboard bug)
